Name: 无日之城
TotalDescribe: <main>白曜圣庭诞生在没有真正太阳的时代。为了让城市继续拥有昼夜、礼拜、净化和灾厄预警，圣庭制造了第二日轮。你翻开被灼痕封住的记录，纸页边缘仍有金白色余温。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>白曜聖庭誕生在沒有真正太陽的時代。為了讓城市繼續擁有晝夜、禮拜、淨化和災厄預警，聖庭製造了第二日輪。你翻開被灼痕封住的記錄，紙頁邊緣仍有金白色餘溫。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>The sanctuary built the second sun in a sunless age. A scorched record still keeps its pale gold warmth.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The sanctuary built the second sun in a sunless age. A scorched record still keeps its pale gold warmth.</main>
1Describe: <main>校准第一缕晨辉</main><add>获得100金币和晨辉碎片</add><subtip>那是从腐坏天幕中提炼出的第一缕无污染光。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>校準第一縷晨輝</main><add>獲得100金幣和晨輝碎片</add><subtip>那是從腐壞天幕中提煉出的第一縷無污染光。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Calibrate dawnlight</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Morning Shard</add><subtip>The first clean light from the stained sky.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Calibrate dawnlight</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Morning Shard</add><subtip>The first clean light from the stained sky.</subtip>

TotalDescribe_en: <main>Una once managed mirrors and bells. She believed light could be measured and assigned.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>Una once managed mirrors and bells. She believed light could be measured and assigned.</main>

Name: 光中的污染

TotalDescribe_en: <main>The Abyss stained the sky. Corruption nested inside light and entered flesh and prayer.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The Abyss stained the sky. Corruption nested inside light and entered flesh and prayer.</main>

1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>檢驗日心棱鏡</main><add>獲得100金幣和日心棱鏡</add><subtip>純淨的光會折出晨色，帶污的光只會沉成黑金。</subtip>

Name: 终章名册
TotalDescribe:
乌娜展开白曜圣庭最后一册名录。纸页已经烧穿，留下来的不是编号，而是还能被呼唤的人。
守夜人伊莱，最后一次敲响黄昏钟。
病房里的孩子，曾向第二日轮许愿。
无名修女，把晨辉碎片藏入圣台。
镜阵工匠，在天幕污染前校准了最后一面环日镜。
圣庭抄写员，在乌娜名字烧穿前留下半行笔迹。
城墙下的母亲，把灰烬护符交给陌生旅人。
最后一位晨祷者，仍相信黑夜之后会有回答。
授冕圣座旁的侍童，记得乌娜曾经害怕过。
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant:
烏娜展開白曜聖庭最後一冊名錄。紙頁已經燒穿，留下來的不是編號，而是還能被呼喚的人。
守夜人伊萊，最後一次敲響黃昏鐘。

城牆下的母親，把灰燼護符交給陌生旅人。
最後一位晨禱者，仍相信黑夜之後會有回答。
授冕聖座旁的侍童，記得烏娜曾經害怕過。
TotalDescribe_en:
Una opens the White Radiance Court's last ledger. The pages are burned through. What remains is not a list of numbers but people who can still be called by name.
Eli the watchman rang the dusk bell one last time.
A child in the ward once prayed to the Second Sun.
An unnamed sister hid a morning shard beneath the altar.
A mirrorwright aligned the last orbit mirror before the canopy was stained.
A court scribe left half a line before Una's name burned through.
A mother beneath the wall handed an ash charm to a stranger.
The last dawn-prayer still believed night would answer.
The child beside the coronation throne remembered that Una had once been afraid.
